invariant: Steady-state energy balance of the boiler component (shared by the old and new semantics): let QFue=heat released by fuel(≥0), Qport=heatPort.Q_flow(positive from environment→boiler), Hw=m_flow*(h_out-h_in)(heat gained by the working fluid); then the heat carried away by the flue gas E = QFue + Qport - Hw must satisfy 0 ≤ E ≤ QFue; in particular, when y=0 (QFue=0), E=0, i.e. Hw = Qport: when the burner is off, the heat lost by the working fluid is exactly equal to the heat received by the environment, and energy is neither created from nothing nor destroyed. Applies to energyDynamics=SteadyState (or t→∞ under constant inputs).
convention_note: The definition of efficiency (useful heat vs heat transferred to water) is a convention; the invariant uses only the flue-gas heat ∈ [0,QFue] and the absence of energy creation/destruction at y=0, which both definitions must satisfy
